findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regex usage in tomli
 * @description Regex patterns used in the codebase
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/regex-usage
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "fullmatch", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn"]).getACall()
select call, "Regex operation that could be vulnerable to regex injection if pattern comes from user input"
findings.hypothesis: Regex injection vulnerability in TOML parser where regex patterns from user input could cause denial of service
